title: GE Appliances — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for GE Appliances.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Good Things for Life." GE Appliances has been in American kitchens since 1907. Now owned by Haier Group, they have invested billions in US manufacturing — multiple factories in Louisville, Kentucky. The UltraFresh Vent system on front-load washers solved the mold and odor problem that plagued the entire industry. Fingerprint Resistant stainless is standard across the line.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Mainstream buyers who want American-made quality with smart features. Builder and renovation projects. Anyone upgrading from basic to connected appliances.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for GE Appliances:

• UltraFresh Vent with OdorBlock — only washer that actively prevents mold and odor buildup

• Made in Louisville, KY — billions invested in US manufacturing

• Fingerprint Resistant finish standard — not an upgrade like some brands

• WiFi connected across the line with SmartHQ app

• Turbo Cool and Turbo Freeze rapidly chill groceries when you get home from the store
